'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2025 Gujarat factory fire]]
**At least 21 people are killed in an explosion at an illegal fireworks factory in [[Deesa]], [[Gujarat]], [[India]]. [https://www.barrons.com/news/18-dead-in-india-firework-factory-blast-officials-ae4a7ea9 (Barron's)]
*[[2023–2025 Sundhnúkur eruptions]]
**Seismic activity increases near [[Grindavík]], [[Iceland]], with the [[Icelandic Meteorological Office]] reporting that a [[volcanic eruption]] has occurred and a earthquake is being registered. People visiting the [[Blue Lagoon (geothermal spa)|Blue Lagoon]] are evacuated rapidly. [https://watchers.news/2025/04/01/volcanic-eruption-reported-near-grindavik-iceland/ (''The Watchers'')]
*[[2025 Putra Heights pipeline fire]]
**At least 305 people are injured after a [[gas pipeline]] owned by [[Petronas]] explodes and ignites a fire in [[Putra Heights]], [[Selangor]], [[Malaysia]]. [https://www.malaymail.com/news/malaysia/2025/04/01/what-we-know-so-far-about-the-puchong-gas-pipeline-inferno/171544 (''Malay Mail'')]
*A small airplane crashes into a lake in [[Os, Hordaland|Os]] near [[Bergen]], [[Norway]], killing the two people onboard. [https://www.smp.no/nyheter/i/GybEPJ/soek-etter-savnet-smaafly-i-vann-i-bjoernafjorden-to-personer-om-bord (''Sunnmørsposten'')]
